images.title: Pilgrim Reliquary
images.possible_role: Restoration / endurance through a journey
images.lore_status: Proposed card concept; working name and gameplay role, not implemented
images.brief: An open palm-sized reliquary rests on the edge of an ordinary pilgrim's unpacked satchel. Invent a restrained six-sided ivory ceramic case held together by a few old gold-brass ribs. Within its dark blue cloth lining lies a small weathered pale stone, ordinary-looking and cherished, no bones or visible god. Its hinged lid is propped open, revealing scuffed fastening and practical hinge. View from above at an intimate diagonal; case, stone and worn bag buckle form the focus. Cold dawn shadows in rough brown leather contrast with a soft shaft of honey light across the white case. One end of a walking stick and a folded cream cloth imply the traveller without showing a character. A faint warm reflection belongs to sunlight, not a glowing magical gemstone. Simple surrounding ground, no elaborate shrine, jewelry advertisement or piles of relics.
